prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. The red-haired lad in the grey hoodie stands beside the tall black server cabinet on the right of frame, phone pressed to his chest in his left hand, his right hand at the small socket on the cabinet's side with the white cable plug. He is looking back over his shoulder toward the counters. He turns his head back toward the cabinet, slides the plug home into the socket with a small push of effort, then quickly glances back over his shoulder a second time, eyes narrowed, checking the hall. Nobody looks his way. He turns back, lets out a slow breath, and the corner of his mouth lifts into a tiny, smug smile, mouth closed. The cabinet lights keep blinking green and blue. The people at the distant counters stay where they are. The POWER signs keep their exact letters. Same light throughout.
Natural documentary realism, overcast daylight.
Thanks.
